address_gate.behavior: Explicit Continue button; invalidated address hides estimator and request fields.

pricing.subject: Residential SiteSee Real Estate Quote
pricing.delivery: mailto draft in visitor email app; self-copy or sales@sitesee.ai request
pricing.photography_checkbox: Always checked, disabled and gray; enforced by quote engine
pricing.property_size_input: Numeric only; disabled for Silver, Gold and Platinum; enabled for Individual Services

market_choice.name: property-type
market_choice.behavior: Separate hidden form panels; preserve selections within each market.

commercial.fields: Same required address, agent, preference and appointment fields as residential
commercial.subject: Commercial SiteSee Real Estate Quote
commercial.extended_term_premium: (photography + aerial + video) * 0.30 / 12 * max(0, total months - 6); first six included, 18 months total maximum
commercial.unlimited_basis: Property photography, aerial images and video only; exclude Matterport, individual 360 views, platform, website and floor plans
commercial.mixed_video_unlimited_license: Included in the 50% media licensing base

matterport_extended_hosting.formula: max(0, total months - 6) * selected monthly rate

commercial.photography: Automatically included by selected category: Small 750; Warehouse / Office 1200; Factory / Industrial 2500; extra photos charged above category allowance. No area-based photography pricing.
commercial.factory_rate_status: Fixed $2500 category fee plus extra photographs; previous $0.05 per additional square foot is removed by latest correction
commercial.matterport_area: Separate number input, 1 sq ft through total property size; does not alter photography fee

single_360_photos.disabled_until: Both Matterport and SiteSee platform selected

platform.excludes: Media licensing, Matterport capture and hosting

photography_quantities.additional_fee_basis: Only photos above the category included maximum

commercial.independent_website_selection: Services add-on checkbox synchronized with delivery radio; $175 charged once; available alongside platform
